name: Paco
description: Paco is a Mexican gambling rummy closely related to Conquian. Players meld runs and identical-card sets, use forcing to block opponents, and pay the winner based on 'pay cards' (1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12) melded. A massive 200-card deck made of five Spanish packs allows for sets of identical cards, a key departure from standard rummy.

content.text: Paco is a Mexican gambling rummy closely related to Conquian. Players meld runs and identical-card sets, use forcing to block opponents, and pay the winner based on 'pay cards' (1, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12) melded. A massive 200-card deck made of five Spanish packs allows for sets of identical cards, a key departure from standard rummy.

Paco evolved from Conquian in Mexico. Conquian was first documented in Mexico City in 1857 and spread to North America; Paco emerged as its popular gambling variant, played mostly by the older generation.

items.text: Team Paco: With 4, 6, 8, etc. players, form two teams. Players sit between opponents. Winning team shares proceeds.
